summary: Origin Agritech, a Nasdaq-listed Chinese crop-seed company, furnished a Form 6-K disclosing an October 27, 2026 Nasdaq Listing Qualifications notice that its ordinary shares closed below the $1.00 minimum bid price for 30 consecutive business days under Rule 5550(a)(2). The deficiency is not immediately delisting; the company received a 180-day compliance period running to April 26, 2027. Regaining compliance requires a $1.00 close for at least ten consecutive business days. Origin may pursue a reverse stock split and could qualify for a second 180-day period if it meets market-value and other initial standards. Watch for a reverse-split announcement and any hearing risk.
